# pages_my subpackage route missing causes page not found
The Vue file `pages_my/setting/userInfo` exists but was not registered in the `pages_my` subpackage of `pages.json`, causing the mini-program to report `page not found`.

## Description
- `pages_my/setting/userInfo.vue` file exists but the `pages_my` subpackage pages array in `pages.json` lacks its route
- Mini-program throws `page not found` on navigation to the page
- `setting/realInfo` (real-name info) route was also missing from `pages.json`

## Solution
- Register `setting/userInfo` (title "Personal Info") route in `pages.json`
- Register `setting/realInfo` (title "Real-name Info") route in `pages.json`

# relative path normalized to slash causes page not found
The "Add" button in `pages_owner/house/index.vue` used relative path `TypeChoose?...`; `normalizeLegacyPageUrl` in `utils/route-map.js` only prepends a leading slash for non-`/` paths, resolving to `/TypeChoose` and causing `navigateTo:fail page not found`.

## Description
- `pages_owner/house/index.vue` "Add" button used relative path `TypeChoose?...`
- `utils/route-map.js` `normalizeLegacyPageUrl` only prepends a leading slash for non-`/` paths
- Resolved to `/TypeChoose` which is not a valid page, causing `navigateTo:fail page not found`

## Solution
- `goto` calls must pass absolute subpackage paths, avoiding relative path usage
- Avoid relative path usage in navigation calls

## Verification
- Source evidence: src=苏住房C/074.md

# news detail migrated to subpackage but homepage jumps old path
News detail page moved to `pages_main/news/detail` subpackage, but `Home_Suzhufang.vue`'s `goNewsDetail` still navigated to undefined `/pages/news/detail` in `pages.json`, causing MiniProgramError.

## Description
- News detail page migrated to `pages_main/news/detail` subpackage
- `Home_Suzhufang.vue` `goNewsDetail` still jumped to `/pages/news/detail` not defined in `pages.json`
- Caused MiniProgramError on navigation

## Solution
- `Home_Suzhufang.vue` uses `route-map.js` `PAGES.news.detail()` to generate correct path
- `menuRouteMap.js` updated menu routes `3_1_10`, `3_1_16` etc. to `pages_main` subpackage
